description: Product dashboard for CI stability and duration. Source: synthetic XLSX with 120 runs across eight conditional weeks.

panels.description: Доля success среди завершённых запусков. Cancelled исключены из знаменателя.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'success') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('success','failed')), 0) AS "Success Rate"
FROM ci_runs
WHERE week IN (${week:csv})
  AND change_size IN (${change_size:sqlstring})
  AND status IN (${run_status:sqlstring});

panels.title: Success Rate

panels.description: Медиана полного ожидания. По умолчанию отменённые запуски не выбраны.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY total_duration_min)::double precision AS "Median Duration"
FROM ci_runs
WHERE week IN (${week:csv})
  AND change_size IN (${change_size:sqlstring})
  AND status IN (${run_status:sqlstring});

panels.title: Median Pipeline Duration

panels.description: 90-й перцентиль полного ожидания: 90% выбранных запусков завершились быстрее.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY total_duration_min)::double precision AS "P90 Duration"
FROM ci_runs
WHERE week IN (${week:csv})
  AND change_size IN (${change_size:sqlstring})
  AND status IN (${run_status:sqlstring});

panels.title: P90 Pipeline Duration

panels.description: Доля времени ожидания в очереди в суммарном времени выбранных запусков.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 100.0 * SUM(queue_duration_min) / NULLIF(SUM(total_duration_min), 0) AS "Queue Share"
FROM ci_runs
WHERE week IN (${week:csv})
  AND change_size IN (${change_size:sqlstring})
  AND status IN (${run_status:sqlstring});

panels.title: Queue Share

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Runs"
FROM ci_runs
WHERE week IN (${week:csv})
  AND change_size IN (${change_size:sqlstring})
  AND status IN (${run_status:sqlstring});

panels.description: Success / (Success + Failed). Cancelled исключены. Календарных дат в XLSX нет, поэтому условные недели отображаются последовательными недельными интервалами.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  (DATE '2026-01-05' + (week - 1) * INTERVAL '7 days') AS "time",
  100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'success') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('success','failed')), 0) AS "Success Rate"
FROM ci_runs
WHERE week IN (${week:csv})
  AND change_size IN (${change_size:sqlstring})
  AND status IN (${run_status:sqlstring})
GROUP BY week
ORDER BY week;

panels.title: Success Rate по неделям

panels.description: Медианы по неделям. Total = Queue + Execution. Календарных дат нет: ось показывает условные недели как последовательные интервалы.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  (DATE '2026-01-05' + (week - 1) * INTERVAL '7 days') AS "time",
  percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY total_duration_min)::double precision AS "Median Total",
  percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY queue_duration_min)::double precision AS "Median Queue",
  percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY execution_duration_min)::double precision AS "Median Execution"
FROM ci_runs
WHERE week IN (${week:csv})
  AND change_size IN (${change_size:sqlstring})
  AND status IN (${run_status:sqlstring})
GROUP BY week
ORDER BY week;

panels.title: Pipeline Duration по неделям

panels.description: Прокси: XLSX содержит самую долгую проверку, а не этап фактического падения. Tests объединяет unit_tests и integration_tests; Deploy в источнике отсутствует.

targets.rawSql:
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT * FROM ci_runs
  WHERE week IN (${week:csv})
    AND change_size IN (${change_size:sqlstring})
    AND status IN (${run_status:sqlstring})
)
SELECT stage, failures
FROM (
  SELECT 1 AS ord, 'Build' AS stage, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'failed' AND slowest_check_type = 'build')::bigint AS failures FROM filtered
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 2, 'Tests', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'failed' AND slowest_check_type IN ('unit_tests','integration_tests'))::bigint FROM filtered
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 3, 'Style checks', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'failed' AND slowest_check_type = 'style_checks')::bigint FROM filtered
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 4, 'Deploy — нет данных', NULL::bigint FROM filtered
) stages
ORDER BY ord;

panels.title: Ошибки по этапам CI — диагностический прокси

panels.description: Сегментация полного ожидания по размеру изменения.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  change_size AS "Change size",
  percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY total_duration_min)::double precision AS "Median",
  percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY total_duration_min)::double precision AS "P90"
FROM ci_runs
WHERE week IN (${week:csv})
  AND change_size IN (${change_size:sqlstring})
  AND status IN (${run_status:sqlstring})
GROUP BY change_size
ORDER BY CASE change_size WHEN 'S' THEN 1 WHEN 'M' THEN 2 WHEN 'L' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END;

panels.title: Duration по размеру изменения

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  run_id AS "Run",
  week AS "Week",
  change_size AS "Size",
  status AS "Status",
  total_duration_min::double precision AS "Total",
  queue_duration_min::double precision AS "Queue",
  execution_duration_min::double precision AS "Execution"
FROM ci_runs
WHERE week IN (${week:csv})
  AND change_size IN (${change_size:sqlstring})
  AND status IN (${run_status:sqlstring})
ORDER BY total_duration_min DESC
LIMIT 8;

На неделях 5–6: **12,4 / 11,4 мин** против примерно 3 мин ранее.
